The City Council meeting was called to order on Wednesday, May 14, 2025 at 6:03 PM.

INVOCATION

The invocation was led by Pablo Rubio, City Clerk.

ABSENT

Rene Lara spoke.

  Mayor De Paula presented the awards to the Youth Walk of Achievement Recipients.

  Mayor De Paula declared a recess at 6:19 PM.

  Mayor De Paula called the meeting back to order at 6:30 PM.

  Report as required by California Assembly Bill 2561.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Rosario Pozzoli, HR Manager, presented the staff report.

  Luis Schmidt, provided a presentation representing the Management Unit.

  Kevin Nguyen continued the presentation.

  Steve Gomez continued the presentation.

  Jose Martinez continued the presentation.

  Shavon Moore­Cage continued the presentation.

  Juan Serrano continued the presentation.

  Jesus Mendoza spoke.

  Juan Soto, spoke representing the Rank and File Unit.

  Councilmember Vargas spoke.

  Mayor De Paula closed the Public Hearing.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Roa, to receive and
  file.

  The motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; Farfan, Roa, Vargas, Del Rio, De Paula
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 5–0–0–0

D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that the Alternative to Gangs
Membership program will host a Teens Summit on May 17, 2025; a Memorial Day Event will be held on
May 26, 2025; and registration for swimming classes opens on May 24, 2025.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no Oral City Attorney Reports.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Mayor De Paula acknowledged Public Works for National Public Works Week.
